anomalies.observed: R10 is listed with value 1M and is used in series with LED D4, but its MPN/Digikey/LCSC fields identify a 1k resistor. The SPICE deck also models it as 1M.
anomalies.expected: For an LED current-limiting resistor in this position, the intended part is 1k as indicated by the component metadata (MPN=0603WAF1001T5E, Digikey=311-1.00KCRCT-ND, LCSC=C21190). A 1M value is three orders of magnitude too high.

anomalies.impact: The green activity LED D4 will be effectively off or extremely dim because the CM4 open-collector activity pin sees a 1M series resistor instead of the intended 1k.

anomalies.observed: Both isolated CAN transceivers have their primary and secondary ground pins tied to the same common GND net: U10.4=GND1, U10.5=GND2, U11.4=GND1, U11.5=GND2.
anomalies.expected: The specification describes two isolated CAN buses using isolated CAN transceivers. The library part for U10/U11 is an isolated CAN transceiver with separate GND1 and GND2 domains; GND2 should not be shorted to the main GND if isolation is intended.
